title: AI Learning App
description: UI/UX overhaul of an AI-powered learning app for Carnegie Mellon.

caseStudy.blurb: A six-month UI/UX overhaul of an AI-powered learning platform for Carnegie Mellon's Tepper School of Business. I led the redesign end to end, rebuilding the experience around a scalable design system: a unified color and type foundation, reusable button, card, menu, and panel components, and redesigned core flows for campaign creation, bidding, and performance analytics. The result is a cohesive, accessible product that holds up across every learning module.
